title: Continuity of the standard Gaussian distribution function
statement: The standard Gaussian distribution function $\Phi:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$ is continuous on $\mathbb R$.
replaced: The standard Gaussian cumulative distribution function $\Phi:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$, given by $\Phi(t)=\int_{-\infty}^{t}e^{-x^2/2}/\sqrt{2\pi}\,dx$, is continuous on $\mathbb R$.
